dedupe_keys.name: npkgrids global n p2o5 and k2o fertilizer application rates for 173 crops

description: NPKGRIDS is a global georeferenced dataset of fertiliser application rates for all three main nutrients, nitrogen (N), phosphorus as P2O5 and potassium as K2O, for 173 crops as of about 2020. It fuses crop masks with eight published fertiliser datasets built from georeferenced data and national and subnational statistics, and benchmarks national totals against FAO and International Fertilizer Association figures and national statistical offices. It was produced by Thu Ha Nguyen, Fiona Tang, Giulia Conchedda, Francesco Tubiello and colleagues, with FAO involvement, and described in Scientific Data. Coverage is global at 0.05 degree, about 5.6 km at the equator, in WGS84. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 (figshare record). Caveats: it is a single snapshot around 2020, and the fusion of sources with different methods leaves uncertainty that varies by crop and country. For simulation it provides spatial nutrient inputs for crop, water quality and emissions models, and shows where agriculture depends most on imported fertiliser, useful in supply chain disruption and climate adaptation studies. It is related to the global crop-specific nitrogen fertilization record in this catalogue, which gives the nitrogen history since 1961.
